text: 8月19日，沪深两市全天成交额合计25110.43亿元。其中，沪市成交额为12181.08亿元；深市成交额为12929.35亿元；创业板成交额为6381.43亿元。
text_en: On August 19, total turnover for Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was 2,511.043 billion yuan. Shanghai accounted for 1,218.108 billion yuan, Shenzhen 1,292.935 billion yuan, and ChiNext 638.143 billion yuan.
